summary.purpose: 南洋奧援 tier 1 ("抽1張牌，再從所有手牌中棄掉1張牌") used to hard-pop the last hand card, which was always the just-drawn card (drawn cards are appended to the end of hand) — a net no-op with no real player choice. Fixed by offering a genuine pending choice over the whole hand. This proves the choice is real: the player can choose to discard a DIFFERENT card and keep the just-drawn one, not just reproduce the old fixed outcome.
